species_support: human CCL27/CCR10 and CCL27/CCL28 receptor-specificity studies
evidence_summary: Primary chemokine studies establish CCL27/CCR10 signaling and distinguish CCL28/CCR3 specificity, but no exact primary experiment was verified for the CCL27B-to-listed-receptor candidates.
limitations: Retain mature CCL27-CCR10 and CCL28-CCR3 specificity separately; resolve the CCL27B species/isoform identity before promotion and do not transfer paralog or receptor-family evidence to ACKR2, CCR2, CCR3, GRM7, MTNR1A or ADRA2A.
